oag-wave-depth.steer: I do think we should cap the depth so players don’t get lost in the minutiae. We can have a notice that lets them know they are going in too deep and they might next external support about it and maybe a link to booking a call with me

enc-inner-moves.steer:
Not all moves take HP away. I think if we are going to use WAVE as the main loop we should explore what each step does as it connects to the basic integral moves 

(Wake up open up clean up grow up and show up )

enc-wave-set.steer:
I think welcome allows the player to see what the opponent actually is. We need a way for a random charge to emerge and by going through the game the players see what type of enemy is emerging

For instance the acknowledge phase would be where the spirit would get a name

Validate would add it to a record of spirits the player has encountered and is working through like a pokedex 

Exhale could be release the spirit OR integrate the spirit (express)

I think I want to do a full brainstorm on how these mechanics could work
